\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsthm}
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newcommand{\lean}[1]{}

\title{Sums of Even Numbers}
\author{A synthetic example}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:two}
The sum of two even natural numbers is even.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:four}
The sum of four even natural numbers is even.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:three}
The sum of three even natural numbers is even.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:double}
Twice any number is even.
\end{theorem}

\end{document}
